covers: Design tokens from the Enterapia Figma file: primitive colors and sizes, semantic color (light and dark), spacing, border width, radius, typography (variables and text styles), elevation and focus.
doesNotCover: Component code, variants and usage guidelines (planned for a later release).
Layout grids, opacity, icon size, breakpoints, motion and z-index (not defined in Figma yet).
notes: Dark theme: set data-theme="dark" on <html>, or leave it unset to follow the system preference. Tokens with a dark variant list both values.
Text styles (text.*) are CSS font shorthands: weight, size/line-height and family. Letter spacing is 0 in every style and is not part of the shorthand.
Semantic tokens alias primitives, so a change to a primitive reaches every semantic token that uses it.
